descriptionChirho: A feminine noun denoting a song or act of singing, used for liturgical and celebratory compositions in Scripture. All three clusters represent the same lexeme שִׁירָה in different grammatical frames: definite (הַשִּׁירָה, eng 'the song', spa 'el cántico', arb الْأُنْشُودَةُ, kor 그 노래, swa 'wimbo'), construct (שִׁירַת, eng 'song of', spa 'canción de', hin गीत, arb أُغنِيَة), and prepositional-construct (כְּשִׁירַת, eng 'like song of', spa 'como canto de', hin गीत की तरह, arb كَأُغْنِيَةِ, kor 노래 같으니, swa 'kama wimbo'). The consistent translation across all languages confirms a single semantic sense.
